```{r setup}
# install.packages(c("MASS", "psych", "lavaan"))
library(MASS)
library(psych)
library(lavaan)
```

```{r simulate}
set.seed(123)
n_samples <- 500

# --- Latent factors (TLB = Team Learning Behavior, TP = Team Performance,
#     IM = Internal Motivation, JI = Job Involvement) ---
latent_means <- c(TLB = 4.8, TP = 5.3, IM = 5.6, JI = 4.1)

factor_cov <- matrix(c(
  1.00, 0.42, 0.30, 0.18,
  0.42, 1.00, 0.25, 0.12,
  0.30, 0.25, 1.00, 0.32,
  0.18, 0.12, 0.32, 1.00
), nrow = 4, byrow = TRUE,
dimnames = list(names(latent_means), names(latent_means)))

latent <- as.data.frame(mvrnorm(n_samples, mu = latent_means, Sigma = factor_cov))

# --- Helper: latent score + noise, rounded and bounded to a 1-7 Likert item ---
make_item <- function(latent_score, noise_sd) {
  pmax(1, pmin(7, round(latent_score + rnorm(length(latent_score), 0, noise_sd))))
}

# --- Generate all items (all positively worded, so no reverse scoring needed) ---
my_data <- data.frame(
  # Team Learning Behavior (7 items)
  sapply(1:7, function(i) make_item(latent$TLB, 0.85)),
  # Team Performance (5 items)
  sapply(c(0.90, 0.85, 0.75, 1.00, 0.90), function(s) make_item(latent$TP, s)),
  # Internal Motivation (3 items)
  sapply(1:3, function(i) make_item(latent$IM, 0.70)),
  # Job Involvement (1 item)
  make_item(latent$JI, 1.15)
)
colnames(my_data) <- c(paste0("TLB_", 1:7), paste0("TP_", 1:5),
                       paste0("IM_", 1:3), "JI_1")

# --- Split into EFA and CFA halves ---
in_efa   <- sample(c(TRUE, FALSE), n_samples, replace = TRUE)
efa_data <- my_data[in_efa, ]
cfa_data <- my_data[!in_efa, ]
```

```{r efa}
# Exclude single-item JI_1 from EFA
efa_items <- efa_data[, 1:15]

fa.parallel(efa_items, fa = "fa", n.iter = 100)

efa_result <- fa(efa_items, nfactors = 4, rotate = "oblimin", fm = "pa")
print(efa_result$loadings, cut = 0.3)
```

```{r cfa}
cfa_model <- '
  Team_Learning =~ TLB_1 + TLB_2 + TLB_3 + TLB_4 + TLB_5 + TLB_6 + TLB_7
  Performance   =~ TP_1 + TP_2 + TP_3 + TP_4 + TP_5
  Motivation    =~ IM_1 + IM_2 + IM_3
'

cfa_fit <- cfa(cfa_model, data = cfa_data, meanstructure = TRUE)
summary(cfa_fit, fit.measures = TRUE, standardized = TRUE)
```
